keyDates.text: DHS Duration-of-Status rule takes effect -- F-1 and J-1 students now admitted for fixed periods (max 4 years). International travel after this date converts students to new fixed-date regime.
Comment deadline for ED's sweeping accreditation overhaul NPRM (published Aug. 20). Rule would eliminate regional vs. national accreditor distinction; effective date targeted July 1, 2027.
End of Federal Fiscal Year 2026. Government now funded through Dec. 11 via CR signed by President Trump. FY2027 full appropriations remain unresolved.
Most Ivy League Early Decision and Early Action deadlines for the 2026-27 cycle (Class of 2031). Penn ED deadline confirmed Nov. 1. Harvard, Yale, Princeton REA also Nov. 1.
ED target date to finalize accreditation overhaul rule. If finalized by Nov. 1, rule takes effect July 1, 2027, giving accreditors less than a year to prepare.

Current continuing resolution expires. Congress must pass FY2027 full appropriations or another stopgap. Education, NIH, NSF funding levels again at stake -- post-midterm political dynamics uncertain.
Regular Decision deadline for Harvard, Yale, Columbia, Brown, Penn (Jan. 2 for Cornell and Dartmouth) -- 2026-27 cycle (Class of 2031). Decisions release late March 2027.
National College Decision Day. All admitted students must confirm enrollment. Brown and all Ivy League schools expect yield decisions for Class of 2031 by this date.
